desc_en: A timeless silhouette defined by clean lines and understated elegance. Crafted with precision to offer an immaculate drape. This long-sleeve shirt brings refined versatility to the contemporary wardrobe. Its clean design transitions fluidly between formal tailoring and daytime sophistication. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping available.

Cada pieza se confecciona bajo pedido en nuestros talleres globales.
